slides.texte_overlay:
weird habits that made me
a morning person

the alarm across the room

i put my alarm on the other side of the room, so i'm standing before my brain can argue. it felt cruel for a week, then it became completely normal for me.

breakfast i look forward to

i plan a breakfast i'm genuinely excited about the night before. giving myself something to look forward to makes getting out of a warm bed so much easier, even in winter.

opening the window

i open the window as soon as i get up, whatever the weather. the fresh air wakes me up faster than coffee, and it makes the whole room feel brand new.

one lesson with coffee

i spend 5 minutes over coffee learning one new thing: a myth, a planet, a painting. starting the day curious made mornings feel like something to enjoy.

one lesson with coffee

i spend 5 minutes over coffee on one lesson: a myth, a planet, a painting. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and starting curious made mornings enjoyable.

slides.texte_overlay:
the same bedtime

i go to bed at the same time every night, weekends included. the real secret of mornings was always the night before, and nobody ever bothered to tell me that.
